product_outcome: Every retained MCU workflow is reachable through agenterm-cu without Bun.

process.owner: agenterm-platform process facades exposed by agenterm-cu

capabilities.acu_shape: ps --pid/--parent/--name/--offset/--max
process-state --pid N
process-usage --pid N
process-wait --pid N --start-identity ID --timeout-ms N
capabilities.note: ACU retains a native process object and requires prior identity; this is stronger than MCU PID polling.

capabilities.next: typed bounded process-detail and filter facades

capabilities.mcu_shape: process usage PID --watch S --interval S --max-samples N
capabilities.acu_shape: process-usage --pid N --watch-ms N --interval-ms N --max-samples N
capabilities.note: Every sample is identity-bound; completed and truncated are distinct.

capabilities.acu_shape: process-watch with composable --pid/--name/--parent filters or explicit --all, plus four independent budgets
capabilities.note: The baseline and every started/exited event carry pid plus start identity; PID reuse is two events, never target substitution.

capabilities.next: identity-bound actuate gate plus post-state
exact identity, actuate grant, pre-state and independently verified postcondition
process-image facade with typed denied/needs-privilege
bounded values-off-by-default process-image facade
bounded names-only default and explicit value exposure
platform observation facades, then qjswasm bounded stream composition
join process identity with the future network socket facade
platform-limited policy adapter plus explicit privilege broker
Linux cgroup v2 observation facade

desktop.owner: agenterm-cu commands over agenterm-platform, native accessibility adapters and CDP

capabilities.acu_shape: windows plus windows-watch with bounded filters and native z-order/occlusion/space metadata
capabilities.note: The common inventory exists; every MCU argument shape still needs contract-level parity classification.

capabilities.mcu_shape: tree/query/elements/inspect/find/read with depth, scan, result, state, action and region bounds
capabilities.acu_shape: tree/query plus inspect/find/read aliases, flat results and typed truncation metadata

capabilities.mcu_shape: focused PID with bounded identity filters
capabilities.acu_shape: focused --window HANDLE
capabilities.note: Linux and Windows are implemented but their current native journeys do not prove every filter shape.

capabilities.mcu_shape: invoke HANDLE selector|index ACTION [value] with postconditions
capabilities.acu_shape: invoke with stable selector/index, grant, receipts and explicit verification
verify/wait with typed present/absent/change results
observe notifications|poll-diff plus windows-watch
capabilities.note: ACU exposes native notifications and portable poll-diff as distinct truthful mechanisms.

capabilities.acu_shape: snapshot/diff/zoom/hit with stable ids and advance receipts
window-place plus aliases frame/movewin/resize/maximize/orderwin/raise
close/minimize/restore/focus with post-state readback
click/drag/scroll and pointer-move --to desktop with explicit actuate grant

capabilities.mcu_shape: click/move/drag/scroll --to HANDLE including optional macOS private provider
capabilities.next: retain semantic accessibility actions as the default; only add a raw exact-window provider with independent delivery and postcondition evidence

capabilities.acu_shape: send-text/send-keys/paste and semantic set-value through invoke
screenshot --window plus page-screenshot for CDP targets

capabilities.mcu_shape: menu inspect APP and menu APP --path
capabilities.acu_shape: menu-inspect/menu-invoke --window HANDLE
capabilities.note: ACU intentionally binds the operation to a stable window instead of an ambiguous app name.

capabilities.acu_shape: app launch|quit|hide|show plus compatibility aliases
clipboard-read/write/write-file/clear with bounded bytes, native type names and digests
capabilities.next: add non-destructive text and native-type round-trip leaves to each platform journey

capabilities.acu_shape: displays and spaces
capabilities.note: Spaces are a truthful macOS-only surface; displays are cross-platform.

capabilities.mcu_shape: setup/doctor/caps with active dependency and permission probes
capabilities.acu_shape: capabilities reports typed status and permission blockers; setup/doctor are absent
capabilities.next: ship a read-only doctor first, then explicit setup plans whose mutations remain outside capability discovery

capabilities.acu_shape: grant/grant-id and receipts; no public session, target-lock or audit lifecycle
capabilities.next: typed control-session facade shared with remote targets; preserve at-most-once receipts and independently verified postconditions

capabilities.note: Visual pointer decoration is not required for machine control replacement and has no effect authority.

browser.owner: agenterm-cu CDP client plus native accessibility browser adapters

capabilities.mcu_shape: page targets and page read --js with automatic or explicit target selection
capabilities.acu_shape: page-targets and page-js with explicit port/profile and target id/url/title
capabilities.note: ACU requires unambiguous target addressing and preserves typed not-found/ambiguous failures; MCU auto-pick shapes remain an adapter gap.

capabilities.mcu_shape: page read plus browser debug-read over DOM/accessibility content
capabilities.acu_shape: page-text and page-find over explicit CDP target, or native accessibility window
page-click/page-fill/page-nav with exact target and node/selector plus receipts
capabilities.note: Background-tab focus preservation and post-state readback are proved on the throwaway macOS court; Windows journey is declared but not yet promoted to evidence.

capabilities.acu_shape: page-screenshot with exact target and typed unavailable result

capabilities.mcu_shape: page hover/scroll/drag/dialog/files and right/double click variants
capabilities.acu_shape: page-click supports button/click count; hover/scroll/drag/dialog/files are absent
capabilities.next: add exact-target CDP verbs with bounded waits, receipts and background-focus invariants

capabilities.acu_shape: tab-list/tab-select/tab-close bound to a stable browser window

capabilities.mcu_shape: browser profile inventory and browser open
capabilities.acu_shape: browser-profiles/browser-open using an existing local profile
capabilities.note: This does not claim ownership of profile creation, leasing or cleanup.

capabilities.mcu_shape: browser profile create/list/start/status/stop/remove with owner lease and TTL
capabilities.next: owned browser process/profile lifecycle facade with recoverable removal and no foreground takeover

capabilities.mcu_shape: browser bridge setup/status/reload plus attached-profile session and target locks
capabilities.next: versioned Native Messaging transport, fixed extension identity, profile-instance routing and at-most-once receipts

capabilities.mcu_shape: browser debug-read/debug-type/debug-invoke/debug-files across frames and closed shadow DOM
capabilities.next: MV3 debugger facade with exact tab/frame/node identity, bounded traversal, detach cleanup and secret-free receipts

capabilities.acu_shape: generic windows/window-place/minimize/restore plus browser profile metadata
capabilities.next: profile-scoped browser window identity/state facade with foreground-preservation postconditions
define bounded download ownership, destination integrity and cleanup before implementation

pty-job-terminal.owner: agenterm terminal/session kernel, agenterm-platform process and PTY adapters, exposed through typed agenterm-cu facades

capabilities.mcu_shape: pty list|panes|status for sessions owned by the terminal product
capabilities.acu_shape: future typed ACU facade over agenterm cli list-sessions|list-panes|pane-snapshot
capabilities.next: expose the existing AgenTerm control protocol through ACU without duplicating terminal state or parsing human-formatted output
capabilities.note: The owning kernel is shipped, but direct agenterm CLI reachability is not yet an ACU facade or ACU black-box evidence.

capabilities.mcu_shape: pty start|split|kill-pane|stop for an owned terminal hierarchy
capabilities.acu_shape: future typed ACU facade over agenterm cli new-session|new-window|kill-window|kill-session
capabilities.next: bind stable session/tab ids, explicit close intent, bounded shutdown and remain-on-exit semantics
capabilities.note: AgenTerm has tabs rather than tmux panes; the facade must preserve product tree and last-tab invariants instead of pretending tmux parity.

capabilities.acu_shape: future typed ACU facade over capture-pane|send-keys|paste-buffer|wait-pane
capabilities.next: add bounded structured capture, literal input, deterministic contains/dead waits and typed target-not-found results
capabilities.note: Generic desktop accessibility can inspect a visible terminal, but it is not equivalent to reading and writing the owned PTY stream.

capabilities.acu_shape: future typed ACU facade over pane-snapshot, capture-pane and read-events/wait-events
capabilities.next: define cursor/epoch identity, output ceilings, truncation and snapshot-advance receipts before routing

capabilities.acu_shape: future facade over AgenTerm ui resize, scroll-pane and screenshot-pane
capabilities.next: separate PTY dimensions, viewport scroll and rendered screenshot instead of collapsing them into one resize claim
portable owned-headless-PTY facade in agenterm-platform with Windows ConPTY and POSIX PTY adapters, stable identity and stale-owner reclamation
capabilities.note: A visible AgenTerm tab is an alternative product surface, not a substitute for an arbitrary background PTY.

capabilities.mcu_shape: pty --provider native|tmux read|send|wait|events with cursors and byte/event limits
capabilities.next: bounded binary-safe read/write/event stream with monotonic cursors, typed truncation, deadline and owner cleanup
terminal-cell snapshot/diff contract plus independently verified rows and columns; do not infer a screen from raw bytes
identity-bound foreground process-group operations with signal delivery receipt, post-state and bounded forced cleanup
keep tmux as an optional delegated provider after the generic PTY contract exists
capabilities.note: tmux topology is provider-specific; ACU replacement does not require installing tmux or claiming one AgenTerm tab has tmux pane semantics.

capabilities.mcu_shape: job spawn|adopt|list|status|prune with request id, cwd, env, limits and ownership
capabilities.next: typed owned-job registry over agenterm-platform spawn/process references with atomic receipts and bounded terminal-record retention

capabilities.mcu_shape: job output|events|write with independent stdout/stderr cursors and bounded long poll
capabilities.next: binary-safe stdin and dual-stream cursor facade with response ceilings, timeout, terminal event and truncation markers

capabilities.acu_shape: process-usage covers one identity-bound process only
capabilities.next: owned process-group environment and aggregate resource views; never label single-process metrics as group coverage
lease-authorized process-group mutation with read-before, identity recheck, delivery receipt and verified post-state
shared ACU control-session lease primitive with monotonic wait, explicit expiry policy and crash-persistent cleanup receipt
add an explicitly named argv-based command or route through owned jobs; preserve ACU exec --json for serialized CU commands
capabilities.note: The same spelling currently has different meanings and must never be forwarded silently.

file-storage.owner: agenterm-platform filesystem and storage mechanisms, ACU transaction facade, qjswasm for workflow composition

capabilities.mcu_shape: storage devices --max N with physical/block id, media, bus, size and health
capabilities.next: add a bounded typed physical-device inventory to agenterm-platform and expose it through ACU
capabilities.note: The existing platform volume_space query reports capacity for one mounted path; it is not physical-device inventory.

capabilities.mcu_shape: file inspect PATH with object identity, type, mode, owner, size and timestamps
capabilities.next: compose filesystem-entry identity and bounded metadata into a cross-platform ACU observation facade

capabilities.mcu_shape: file xattrs PATH [--values --max N] with byte counts and digests
capabilities.next: define an attribute namespace and bounded value disclosure per platform; never relabel Windows alternate streams as Unix xattrs

capabilities.mcu_shape: file chmod PATH OCTAL [--apply] with plan, identity recheck and readback
capabilities.next: Unix typed plan/apply facade over an opened stable entry; Windows must expose its own ACL/attribute vocabulary instead of fake octal parity

capabilities.mcu_shape: file xattr-set|xattr-remove|quarantine-clear [--apply] with precondition and rollback attempt
capabilities.next: typed attribute plan/apply operation with exact prior value digest, byte ceiling, readback and rollback outcome

capabilities.mcu_shape: file copy SOURCE DEST [--replace --apply] plus status|rollback|recover|finalize
capabilities.next: build the transaction facade from existing no-overwrite/atomic-publish primitives; persist source/destination identity and every recovery state

capabilities.mcu_shape: file move SOURCE DEST [--replace --apply] plus status|rollback|recover|finalize
capabilities.next: separate same-volume rename from cross-volume copy-and-remove and prove rollback/finalize for both

network.owner: agenterm-platform network observation facades and qjswasm network runtime, exposed through agenterm-cu

capabilities.mcu_shape: network interfaces --max N with address, netmask, CIDR, MAC, scope and internal state
capabilities.next: cross-platform bounded interface inventory with stable interface identity and typed unavailable fields

capabilities.mcu_shape: network routes --max N with destination, gateway, interface, flags, table and metric
capabilities.next: native route-table facade with normalized destination/gateway plus preserved platform-specific metadata
typed active resolver/search-domain inventory; Linux must not assume resolv.conf is the complete systemd-resolved state
define per-service DNS identity separately for each OS instead of treating the current macOS networksetup shape as portable
bounded native socket inventory joined to process start identity; expose truncated result and truncated scan independently

capabilities.mcu_shape: network probe HOST --port N --attempts N --timeout-ms N with DNS and TCP latency evidence
capabilities.next: ACU facade composed from qjswasm DNS/TCP calls with per-attempt deadlines, resolved-address evidence and no hidden retry
capabilities.note: qjswasm already carries generic TCP APIs, but a caller cannot yet reach this MCU-shaped probe through the ACU public entry.

device-audio.owner: agenterm-platform device and audio adapters, ACU lease/transaction facade

capabilities.next: bounded cross-platform peripheral inventory with stable device identity and preserved provider-specific properties

capabilities.mcu_shape: device watch with type, duration, interval, inventory and event ceilings
capabilities.next: native notifications where reliable and explicit poll-diff otherwise; report provider truncation separately from event truncation

capabilities.mcu_shape: device claims|claim|renew|release with exclusive TTL secret lease
capabilities.next: shared control-session lease plus platform-specific exclusive-open identity; never accept a path as proof of the same device after reconnect

capabilities.mcu_shape: device read|write with bounded hex bytes under a live lease
capabilities.next: binary-safe bounded reads/writes tied to exact device and lease identity, with partial-I/O receipts

capabilities.mcu_shape: device claim with baud/data-bits/parity/stop-bits/flow and readback
capabilities.next: portable serial vocabulary mapped by native adapters, with unsupported combinations rejected before opening

capabilities.mcu_shape: audio status with default output identity, volume and muted state
capabilities.next: typed default-output facade with truthful backend availability and stable device identity

capabilities.mcu_shape: audio plan volume|muted then apply request+digest, exact before/after readback and rollback request
capabilities.next: plan/apply transaction over the platform audio facade with target revalidation, post-state and rollback receipt
